messages.content: The current `subject.mjs` validates ranges and backs the end off pair boundaries, but it fails to reject an interior surrogate start (a violation of requirement 2). I add that check while preserving everything else.
messages.reasoning_content:
The current subject.mjs already satisfies? Check: validates text string, offset range, splits pairs. It doesn't check start interior? Interior start: offset>0 && offset<len && splitPair(offset) — need(end>offset||offset===text.length) but doesn't reject interior start explicitly. Also splitPair(offset) when end=offset empty slice at interior start: allowed but should reject interior start. Also end check: rejects if end splits; but progress check: need(end>offset||offset===text.length) — if end moved back to offset due to split pair, throws. That's "reject nonempty read that cannot make progress". But interior start offset not rejected. Add check: reject interior start unless offset===text.length? Requirement says reject interior start. So add need(!(offset>0&&offset<text.length&&splitPair(offset))||offset===text.length,...). Then empty slice at EOF fine.

Also the end-- could make end<offset when offset>0 and end-1==offset and splitPair(offset)? If offset is interior start... rejected now. If offset at pair start, end=offset+1 splits, end-- → end=offset, then progress check throws — good.

Return fields preserved. Submit.
